messages:
maria_csm: Heads-up — AcmeRetail renewal in 28 days. Usage down 42% q/q, MRR $9.2k. They mentioned cost concerns in last call. Need a short, concrete save plan and a downgrade-deflection path. @jason_successops can you own the play?

jason_successops: Yep, I'll take it. Quick question: are they on monthly or annual?

maria_csm: Monthly commit. Renewal is the subscription anniversary date 2025-05-28. No anchor upsell yet.

oliver_sm: Adding context from last AM call — engineering tickets slowed integration. They dropped realtime repacks which reduced perceived value.

sophie_onboarding: I have the onboarding notes. They never completed the Custom API mapping step (task #24). I can run a short re-onboard session.

retention_bot: RiskScore=7/10 · Signals: usage_down, support_queue>3, billing_flag=false · SuggestedAction=15min-savedemo + targeted credit offer

emma_engage: Suggestion: offer a 3-month discount on Dedicated capacity + complimentary enablement workshop. If they accept downgrade, we keep them on a fenced lower-capacity plan rather than churn.

jason_successops: Proposed micro-play (draft):
```
1) 48h: 15-min executive check-in (maria)
2) 72h: Engineering triage + unblock session (oliver + eng-ops)
3) 5 days: Targeted usage plan + 1-off cost-savings config (sophie)
4) If still at-risk: Offer 10% for 3 months OR migration to lower-tier with feature gating (keep data + support)
5) 14 days: Follow-up health check + renewal decision
```

maria_csm: Love it. Add a short success metric we can promise: 'reduce avg token cost by 20% via batching + cache' — that's actionable and measurable.

oliver_sm: Technically doable: 20% is realistic with prefix caching + tuned batching for their request distribution. I'll prepare the config diff.

sophie_onboarding: I'll run a 30-min targeted onboarding for their SRE and PM. Proposed slots: Tue 10am or Wed 3pm.

jason_successops: I'll draft the outreach email and include the offer language. Proposed subject: "Quick call: options to lower your monthly cost and stabilize throughput".

emma_engage: On the offer: avoid open-ended credits. Prefer fixed-term discount + clear rollback. Also propose a canary for Dedicated burst so they don't lose peak capacity.

maria_csm: Assignments: @jason_successops outreach by EOD, @oliver_sm config diff in 48h, @sophie_onboarding schedule session, @emma_engage prep offer terms with legal. I'll run exec check-in once outreach is sent.

jason_successops: Noted. I'll ping here when outreach is sent and paste the email copy.

retention_bot: Action created: play/1749883333_acmeretail_microplay · Due=1749969733 (7 days) · Owner=jason_successops

maria_csm: Thanks team. Small, measurable steps — goal is to avoid downgrade or at least preserve revenue with a safe downgrade path. I'll post meeting notes after the exec call. :thumbsup:

jason_successops: Outreach sent to client (thread link) — scheduled exec check-in for Tue 10am. Copy of outreach: "Hi Sam — quick call to review options to reduce your monthly spend and stabilize throughput. We have a 30-minute slot Tue 10am — would that work? We can share a short runbook with immediate cost wins."

maria_csm: Confirmed. Leaving this thread open for updates.
